catalogEntry.description: 通过独立本地协议端读取验收样本，可验证当前任务的审批模式。

tool.name: local_sample
tool.description: 仅返回本地验收样本。scenario 指定 structured、dual、error 或 slow；marker 用于核对每次真实调用。没有外部平台副作用。

semantics.activation: Only explicit start-ui --market-acceptance RUN_LABEL in local/demo_fast development. Native, Host and worker independently validate the selector and separated data roots. No acceptance selector in ordinary launcher. Existing qualificationOnly worker artifacts remain rejected. Use the canonical product worker with the explicit acceptance argument; never replace or spoof executables.
semantics.isolation: Native uses its own market-local-acceptance/RUN_LABEL child; Host and Runtime use .local/market-local-acceptance/RUN_LABEL/{host-home,codex-home}. No daily data copy, migration, user account, Keyring credential or credential startup pipe in the local connector. Only this catalog/provider is exposed in acceptance. No arbitrary URL override; fixed loopback MCP only, no redirects.
semantics.execution: The isolated local_sample definition qualifies as a read only when its exact schema matches this profile. Use the current paired Runtime approval policy, Gateway registration, private owner decision and one-shot HTTP permit. A legacy peer uses once-only review. Count received business requests and preserve the actual result metadata.
semantics.model: Default model peer is a plain local Responses protocol service driving benign tool calls. It is not evidence of model quality. An explicitly selected real model may use current owner-authorized credentials and a bounded number of short tasks; local connector requests never go to the supplier.
semantics.evidence: Observe GUI actions, exact original call/approval/decision/thread/turn/Item identities, native SQL47 facts, no-replay normal close/reopen, structured-only/dual/error content and event refresh. Missing evidence remains NOT RUN or FAIL. Diagnostics only in the isolated namespace, bounded, no raw credentials or capability fields.
semantics.rollback: Normal exit then ordinary launcher restores ordinary behavior without touching acceptance records. Never downgrade SQL47 or replay facts. Default product artifact validation, source checks and provider allowlist are unchanged.
